tip: Upgrade to Executive only if you'll book through Costco Travel
value: $65 a year more ($130 vs $65); pays 2% back on Costco Travel and warehouse buys, up to $1,250 a year
how: Break-even is $3,250 of Costco spending in a year. A $3,500 Costco Travel package alone earns about $70, so with normal Costco shopping on top it pays for itself. If you book through CheapCaribbean or Southwest instead, it only pays if you already spend $3,250+ a year at Costco.

tip: Count the free Costco Shop Card as part of the price
value: Seen today: $314 card with Hard Rock Cancun and $142 with JW Marriott Cancun (Jan 16–21, two people)
how: Subtract the card from Costco's price when comparing. Example today: Hard Rock Cancun, Jan 16–21, was $3,597 at Costco with a $314 card (about $3,283 effective) vs $3,658 on CheapCaribbean.

tip: Costco Anywhere Visa adds 3% on travel
value: 3% back on Costco Travel, on top of the Executive 2%
how: Only matters if you have or want that card; your Amex Platinum earns less on packages (see below).

tip: Book flights direct to earn 5x points; packages earn 1x
value: 5 Membership Rewards points per $1 on flights booked with the airline or Amex Travel
how: A package from CheapCaribbean, Costco or Southwest counts as a travel agency purchase (1x). Pay with the Platinum anyway for its trip protections.

tip: Charge the whole trip to the Platinum for trip insurance
value: Trip delay (6+ hours) and trip cancellation/interruption cover when the round trip is paid with the card
how: Read your card's benefit terms before booking; coverage requires the travel to be paid with the card.

tip: Hotel credit works only at Fine Hotels + Resorts or The Hotel Collection
value: Up to $300 back each half-year on prepaid FHR or Hotel Collection stays booked through Amex Travel
how: Few Caribbean all-inclusives are in those programs, so this usually helps on a hotel-only booking, not a package. Sign in at Amex Travel to check a specific resort.

tip: Airline fee credit can pay for bags or seats
value: Up to $200 a year in incidental fees on the one airline you select
how: Pick the airline you're likeliest to fly to the Caribbean (United or American from O'Hare, Southwest from Midway).

tip: Check Amex Offers before you pay
value: Statement credits on travel sites appear in your Amex account
how: Sign in to Amex and look under Offers for CheapCaribbean, Costco Travel or Southwest before checking out.

tip: Southwest packages include 2 free checked bags each
value: Up to $500 off 5-night international packages for two (promo on the site today), plus bags free
how: Southwest now charges for bags on regular tickets; it values the free bags at about $400 round trip for two. Same-trip prices were still $130–400 higher than CheapCaribbean on today's Cancun check.

tip: Look for CheapCaribbean promo codes at checkout
value: Banners today: $200 off 2026 travel, and up to $250 off a first vacation
how: Promos change often; the email will mention any big one it sees.

tip: Flexible dates save more than any membership
value: Today's deals cluster on Monday, Friday and Saturday departures in November, January and February
how: Shifting a trip by a day or two, or flying from Midway instead of O'Hare, often moves the price by hundreds for two.
